svg.text: End-to-end MLOps pipeline — from data ingestion to production monitoring
140K images from HuggingFace — Real (CIFAR-10) + AI (Stable Diffusion)
Image integrity, class balance, resolution stats
Free T4 GPU, interactive notebook, ~20min training
Production T4 GPU, 6-step Kubeflow DAG, auto-deploy
GZip → CORS → Auth (X-API-Key, SHA-256) → Rate Limit (slowapi) → Security Headers → Observability
Upload → Preview → Predict → Heatmap overlay → History (last 10)
Parallel model comparison, agreement tracking, safe canary deployments
Model storage, Docker images, DVC remote
Budget alerts · IAM service accounts · Uptime checks · Auto-provisioned · Remote state on GCS
13 rules across 3 groups with runbook links
Warning threshold: 0.15 · Critical: 0.30 · Teams: backend, ml-engineering, infrastructure
Quality gates: accuracy ≥ 85%, F1 ≥ 80% · Auto-rollback on failure · CodeQL + Trivy security scans · PR preview comments
JPG/PNG/WebP ≤20MB → Compress ≤4.5MB → Resize(224) → Normalize(ImageNet) → EfficientNet-B0 → Sigmoid → {real, ai_generated}
dev (hot-reload, debug) · prod (gunicorn 4 workers, resource limits) · detector-network bridge
